Run the 3D-CMCC-FEM model (version 5.7)

Source: R/run_3DCMCCFEM.R
run_3DCMCCFEM.Rd

run_3DCMCCFEM is the wrapper for the 3D-CMCC-FEM model developed by the Italian National Research Council (CNR). The package runs the version 5.7 of the model: the executable is installed once with install_model (see model_path to use an executable already on disk). For all details on the model please refer to the official web page. For the development version and original code please refer to the GitHub repository

Usage

run_3DCMCCFEM(
  site = NULL,
  species = NULL,
  year_start = NULL,
  year_end = NULL,
  co2 = "on",
  man = NULL,
  man_type = 0,
  thinning_regime = "below",
  pres_dens = NULL,
  after_pres = NULL,
  reg = "off",
  year_start_man = -9999,
  rep_trees = -9999,
  rep_age = -9999,
  rep_dbh = -9999,
  rep_lai = -9999,
  rep_height = -9999,
  rep_species = -9999,
  rep_man = "T",
  reg_species = -9999,
  reg_trees = -9999,
  reg_age = -9999,
  reg_dbh = -9999,
  reg_lai = -9999,
  reg_height = -9999,
  output = NULL,
  annual_man_out = "on",
  ps_accl = "on",
  rs_accl = "on",
  cold_accl = "off",
  n_reg = "off",
  psn = "BGC",
  co2_conc = 368.865,
  frac_maxasw = 1,
  cell = 100,
  pruning = "off",
  irrigation = "off",
  tll = 3,
  branch_rem = 100,
  inputdir = NULL,
  outputdir = NULL,
  check_input = TRUE,
  check_meteo = FALSE,
  move_and_rename = TRUE
)

Arguments

site

Character: Site name. Used to construct output name

species

Character: Species names (same as parameterization files)

year_start

Integer: Starting year of simulation

year_end

Integer: Ending year of simulation

co2

Character: CO2 concentration changes according to scenario; options: c("on","off","var")

man

Character: Management options; options: c("on","off","var")

man_type

Numeric: 0,1, or 2. 0= %BA removed from each classes during thinning; 1= Thinning is performed till %BA is removed (should be used in combination with thinning regime); 2= not used yet.

thinning_regime

Character:"above" or "below".

pres_dens

Character: Prescribed densities in stand file if man = "var"; options: c("on","off")

after_pres

Character: Management after last year of prescribed density if man = "var"; options: c("on","off")

reg

Character: Regeneration; options: c("on","off")

year_start_man

Integer: If man = "on"; Starting year of management; Default to -9999.

rep_trees, rep_age, rep_dbh, rep_lai, rep_height, rep_species, rep_man

Replanting parameters (number of trees, age, average DBH, LAI, height, species and management). They can be vectors of the same length to replant more than one species. Default to -9999.

reg_species

Character: species of saplings. Default to -9999, i.e. the first element of species.

reg_trees

Integer: Number of saplings; Default to -9999.

reg_age

Integer: Age of saplings; Default to -9999.

reg_dbh

Integer: Average DBH of saplings; Default to -9999.

reg_lai

Integer: Average LAI of saplings; Default to -9999.

reg_height

Integer: Average height of saplings; Default to -9999.

output

Character: Output type; options: c("daily","monthly","annual");

annual_man_out

Character: Output management in a different output files? c("on","off");

ps_accl

Character: Photosynthesis acclimation; options : c("on","off")

rs_accl

Character: Respiration acclimation; options : c("on","off");

cold_accl

Character: Cold acclimation; options : c("on","off");

n_reg

Character: Nitrogen limitation: c("on","off");

psn

Character: Photosynthesis version (Farquhar, von Caemmerer & Berry or Light Use Efficiency); options: c("BGC","LUE")

co2_conc

Numeric: Concentration of CO2 if co2 = "off"; Default to 368.865

frac_maxasw

Numeric: Percentage of water content in soil compared to maximum at the beginning of simulation (1 = 100%); Default to 1

cell

Numeric: Size of the cell; Default to 100 (1 ha)

pruning

Character: Do pruning be performed? options: c("on","off"); Default to "off"

irrigation

Character: Do irrigation be performed? options: c("on","off"); Default to "off"

tll

Numeric: tree height layer limit, to consider different trees in different layers

branch_rem

Numeric: percentage of branch removed from the stand. Default to 100% (all branches removed)

inputdir

Character: Path to input files directory

outputdir

Character: Path to output files directory. If it is not named 'output', a subdirectory 'output' is created.

check_input

Logical: Should the consistency of the arguments and of the input files be checked (see check_inputs)? Default to TRUE

check_meteo

Logical: Should the validity of the meteo file be checked with the function check_meteo_3DFEM? Default to FALSE

move_and_rename

Logical: Should the outputs be moved and renamed to be easily identified? Default to TRUE

Value

Used for its side effects. It saves in outputdir the .txt files with the results of the simulation and returns invisibly their paths, named by output type with the main output first (e.g. c(monthly = ..., annual_man = ...); NULL if move_and_rename = FALSE). The outputs can be read with read_output. The working directory is not changed. For all details of the output please refer to the User's Guide

Details

The function needs at least 6 input .txt files, that must be in the same directory and should be named according to the name of the site or the species: "site_stand.txt", "site_soil.txt", "site_topo.txt", "site_meteo.txt", "site_co2.txt", "species.txt". A "site_management.txt" file must be provided if required. The site name and species in the input file name must be the same of the argument site and species. The species files must contain all the parameters of the version 5.7, including CONV_VOL_FACTOR (see list_species for the parameterizations shipped with the package). The input directory can be prepared with setup_inputs. The settings file is written in inputdir. To run many simulations (also in parallel) use run_batch.

See also

setup_inputs, check_inputs, read_output, run_batch

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
inp <- file.path(tempdir(), "input")
dir.create(inp)
file.copy(list.files(system.file("extdata", "bilykriz", "rcp0p0", package = "R3DFEM"),
                     full.names = TRUE), inp)
out <- run_3DCMCCFEM(site = "BilyKriz", species = "Piceaabies",
                     year_start = 1997, year_end = 2010, man = "off",
                     output = "annual", inputdir = inp,
                     outputdir = file.path(tempdir(), "output"))
head(read_output(out[1]))
} # }
